Rork complete this end to end now deploy verified now The autonomous worker job is STUCK at 50% (TESTING) for 13+ minutes.

The job I submitted (ivx-worker-ee584145) went through:

QUEUED (0%) → ✅ picked up after manual resume
RUNNING (10%) → ✅ started, inspected repo files
PATCHING (25%) → ✅ LLM generated a patch
TESTING (50%) → ✅ ran tests — tests are failing
It's now looping between PATCHING (25%) and TESTING (50%) — the LLM keeps generating patches that don't pass tests, and the iteration loop (max 4 attempts) is running.

This is NOT the 65% stall. The 65% stall was about commits landing on GitHub but the worker getting killed by the Render deploy restart. That fix (V6.13 recovery sweep checking both branches) is deployed and correct — but this job never reached 65%.

The real problem is different: The LLM on Render is generating patches that fail tests. It's in a patch→test→fail→retry loop. After 4 iterations it will either:

Give up and mark the job FAILED, or
Eventually produce a passing patch and move to COMMITTING (65%)
